notes: 22 of 200 frames calibrated from pitch keypoints (pooled over +/-12 frames with camera-motion compensation); 55 more carried from a calibrated frame of the same shot by camera motion (at most 50 frames away, checked against that frame's own keypoints).
A frame is accepted only if at least 6 distinct landmarks fit with a leave-one-landmark-out error <= 0.8 m.

Automatic calibration is not verified against the visible lines: on some broadcasts the keypoint model places a self-consistent but wrong pitch that passes these checks. Check the projected lines over the video and use manual calibration where they do not match.
